components.text: The Star Crawler is an armored [color=red]hostile[color] creature that stalks the surface of distant worlds.
Its natural armor makes it tougher than most monsters, and it will relentlessly pursue players and villagers. [br] Approach it with caution and good equipment. [br] [br]
